newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal-Some rail basis offers fall.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal-Some rail basis offers fall.

text.p: Many soymeal basis offers in rail markets were lower Wednesday as end-users refused to buy at levels considered too high, dealers said.
"The basis is weakening," said one dealer. "It seems like everybody is still waiting to buy."
However, in truck markets, basis offers were stable and some merchandisers reported active sales of soymeal.
"We're starting to get behind in loadings," said one dealer. "Things are moving pretty well around here."
Nearby basis offers should find support from a drop in the crush as more processors schedule downtime, dealers said.
A large crusher in northeastern Indiana is said to be going down this weekend for the month of August and possibly part of September, and other plants are taking downtime as well, trade sources said.
The CBOT Wednesday morning announced 30 lots of soymeal were posted for delivery against the the July contract following expiration of that contract on Tuesday.
